title: Multiplicative Subgroups of Prime Fields Are Not Sumsets
summary: Let $H \leq \mathbb{F}_p^*$ be a proper multiplicative subgroup, and suppose that $H = A+B$ for some $A,B \subseteq \mathbb{F}_p$. We prove that either one of the summands is a singleton, or $|A|=|B|=2$ and $|H|=4$. In particular, no proper multiplicative subgroup of $\mathbb{F}_p^*$ can be written as $A+B$ with $|A|,|B|>2$. Our proof builds on the Hanson-Petridis polynomial method and Kalmynin's subsequent resolution of Sárközy's conjecture for quadratic residues.
